comparison.objective: Finish four HELICOIL inserts by tang removal; record installs and retains a shower-valve cartridge with a U-clip.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate holds a mandrel coaxially while another hand strikes it; record holds a spring-back cartridge flush while inserting a clip past its ears.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contact fractures, four recovered tangs, and no insert/shell damage; record requires flush cartridge alignment, fully seated clip, and retention under a 20 N pull. Candidate quantitative thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual constrained operations, but spring-loaded insertion and latching do not test calibrated impact fracture or free-fragment recovery.
